msg: Hi! I've never dived before and I'd love to try it in Cartagena, but I'm very short-sighted (about -5) and I get seasick on boats. Is that a problem? What do you recommend?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely first diving experience! For beginners, I recommend our Dive Mini Course: it includes theory, pool practice, and one reef dive with a PADI instructor, with no prior experience or certification needed.

For your short-sightedness, I don’t have specific information about prescription lenses or vision requirements, so I can’t confirm what would work for you. For seasickness, the speedboat ride is about an hour; having a light breakfast and considering seasickness tablets may help. If you take medication, please ask your doctor whether it’s compatible with diving.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD (475.000 COP · 528.000 COP)

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes, from Cartagena. So can you give me a prescription mask for -5, or should I wear contact lenses? And how do I book for just me?
reply:
Yes, we have prescription masks in diopters 2, 3, and 4, so we don’t have an exact -5 option. You can also dive with contact lenses. Please mention your prescription when booking so the team can prepare the mask if you choose that option.

You can book just for yourself online—there’s no minimum number of people. [Book the Dive Mini Course](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en)

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)

For a first time I'd recommend the *mini-course*: theory, practice in calm water and a sea dive with an instructor, no experience needed. If you want to get certified, there's the *PADI Open Water course*. Shall we go for the mini-course? 🤿
